notes.text: The Menachem article points to Kohelet Rabbah. The checked midrash names Berekhiah transmitting in Yose’s name and Menachem asking a question. The exact addressees of that question are less clear than Heilprin’s summary.

The checked Pesikta puts Azaryah and Yitzchak bar Marion in a group transmitting in the name of Yose bar Rabbi Chanina. Heilprin’s reciprocal Azaryah entry likewise gives a tradition ending in Chanina. The specific ben Chananyah attribution remains open.
